articles.title: Sweat, Shade, and Surprising Tricks to Stay Cool This Summer
articles.summary: Did you know wearing more clothes can actually keep you cooler in the sun? Scientists share weird but true tips—like using potted plants as natural air conditioners—to beat the heat without blasting the AC.

articles.title: Earth at Night: A Flickering Light Show Seen from Space
articles.summary: Imagine a map where cities glow gold if they got brighter and purple if they dimmed. New satellite images reveal how Earth's nighttime lights changed over eight years—some places lit up, others went dark, and the reasons are fascinating.

articles.title: A New $50 Deal for Weight Loss Meds—But There's a Catch
articles.summary: Starting July, some people on Medicare can get popular weight loss drugs like Wegovy for just $50 a month. But the program only lasts until 2027, and the rules are tricky. Here's what you need to know.
